reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 executing a format-1 GO TO procedure-name-1 must transfer control to that paragraph, or to the first paragraph of that section, from any position (forward, backward, out of an inline PERFORM, a PERFORMed range, an IF or an EVALUATE), resolving a qualified or same-section paragraph-name, and refusing an undefined or ambiguous name.

edition-consulted.switches: the target-less GO TO (GoToFormat.AnsiAlterable) is refused from 2002 (BareGotoRemoved2002); legal at 85

not an edition test itself, but ALTER exists only at 85 (AlterRemoved2002 in VersionConformancePass), so only at 85 can a GO TO in an ALTERed paragraph bind as BoundGoToAlterable; every other GO TO binds as BoundGoTo, the latest edition's arm

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior|Edition.Year over ControlFlowBinder.cs (only StopLiteralRemoved2002, for STOP), StatementEmitter.cs and EmitterState.cs: none on the GO TO path; VersionConformancePass#VisitGoToStatement gates only the target-less form.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for GO TO procedure-name-1: same binding and emission at 85 and 2023 (p6 output identical); the 85-only ALTERable arm is GR2/ALTER's subject.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb413 covers GO TO out of an inline PERFORM; not covered: backward and forward paragraph transfer, GO TO a section, qualified paragraph-name, GO TO inside a PERFORMed THRU range and a PERFORMed section, GO TO from an EVALUATE body, refusal of undefined and ambiguous names

probes.printed: START FWD N=01 FWD N=02 FWD N=03 INLINE M=01 OUT-OF-INLINE M=02 RANGE-A RANGE-C BACK-FROM-RANGE O-1 O-3 BACK-FROM-SECTION DUP-IN-S-TWO S-END-E-1
probes.expected: control goes to the named paragraph each time (SKIPPED, RANGE-B, O-2 and the S-THREE DUP never run); GO TO a section reaches its first paragraph; a PERFORM range still returns at its end

probes.printed: GO TO NOWHERE: COBOL1639; unqualified DUP declared in two other sections: COBOL2121 not unique; DUP in the same section: runs S1-DUP
probes.expected: a name that identifies no procedure, or is not unique, is refused; a same-section paragraph-name needs no qualifier

probes.printed: ALTER SW TO PROCEED TO TGT; GO TO SW; SW. GO TO. -> ALTERED-TGT
probes.expected: the 85-only target-less GO TO with ALTER is accepted and transfers to the altered target

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.15.4 GR1  (6.15.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: GO TO procedure-name-1 binds through the one procedure resolution to the target's start pc and emits __pc = target plus a jump in the paragraph dispatcher; every transfer probed reached the named procedure at --std 85, the same as at 2023.

refuter.evidence: t2_goto.cob at --std 85: GO TO into a SECTION 60 (independent segment) and back, backward GO TO within it, GO TO a section with no qualifier, GO TO out of a PERFORMed section skipping SUB-2, GO TO qualified FIN OF S-END in SECTION 55: START SEG N=1 SEG N=2 BARE-P N=2 BARE-P N=3 SUB-3 K=1 FIN N=3. t6_seg.cob (85-only arm): an ALTERed GO TO in an independent segment returns to its initial state when a GO TO from the fixed segment re-enters it (P-A N=1, P-B N=1, P-A N=2), per §1985:XVI.1.4.3 (cite.py 'OK  §1985:XVI.1.4.3 ... it lies in GR3'). Refusals: GO TO a paragraph of the containing program from a nested program COBOL1639; duplicate unqualified paragraph COBOL2121; section-name equal to a paragraph-name COBOL2692. Sentences before a section's first paragraph are refused at 85 (COBOL0900), consistent with the 1985 Procedure Division format. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.6.15.4 GR1  (6.15.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1'.
